title: 复杂②：Webhook 告警触发，读日志、写复盘、回报
notes: A triggered run that does real work: the delivery arrives with no client involved, the bot reads a log file, writes a report and answers. Both the origin and the written file are checked.

triggers.name: deploy alert
triggers.prompt: 收到一条部署告警：读 logs/deploy.log，把根因与建议写进 triage.md，并回一句结论

workspace.logs/deploy.log:
10:02 build ok
10:04 migrate start
10:05 ERROR migrate failed: relation "users" already exists
10:06 rollback start
10:07 rollback done

args.content:
# 复盘

- 根因：迁移重复创建 users 表，relation already exists
- 处置：10:06 回滚，10:07 完成
- 建议：迁移前检查 schema 版本，失败即停

script.text: 根因是迁移重复创建 users 表；已回滚，复盘写在 triage.md。
